description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for '/api/foods' endpoints, including Swagger API documentation, for managing food logs in a calorie tracking application.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list food logs at '/api/foods'.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new food log at '/api/foods'.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific food log by ID.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing food log by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a food log by ID.
